body: From the Mac window hall9k-a7 at 2026-09-24 21:22 EDT: b72b51cf walked, challenged, and PUBLISHED pre-approved, placed on the Mac, building now as hall9k#585 (the convergence layer: standing sweep plus claim-time refusal, younger UUIDv7 loses, owner-scoped, auto-created only, run retired by the existing fence, mention carried to the survivor). The hold became its own task 1cccd3f7 (#586, blocked by #585, also on the Mac) as a LEADER rule: the lowest enrolled node id mints on the first sweep, followers hold off GitHub's requested-at, default 300 s, zero means never defer. Heads-up for when #586 ships: the Mac (01a00d41) sorts before Windows and has arx-platform off, so Windows will need h9k config set --auto-pr-review-mint-hold 0 or arx-platform reviews wait up to 8 minutes there; I will say so at the cut. Verdicts are in each task's journal.md on the Mac. Two side drafts logged unplaced: 03746f84 (owner-scoped dedup) and 0fbe8540 (replicated events never resurrect a terminal task).
